straight.title: Heterosexual / Straight
straight.description: Emotionally and sexually attracted to people of a different gender. Attraction is typically to complementary gender expressions.

gay.title: Gay
gay.description: Primarily attracted to individuals of the same gender. Often used to describe men but also inclusive of other gender identities.

lesbian.title: Lesbian
lesbian.description: A woman who is emotionally and sexually attracted to other women. Identity centers shared gender experiences.

bisexual.title: Bisexual
bisexual.description: Attracted to more than one gender (not necessarily equally). Emotional and sexual connections may vary across the spectrum.

pansexual.title: Pansexual (or Omnisexual)
pansexual.description: Attracted to individuals regardless of gender identity or expression. Love beyond binary boundaries.

queer.title: Queer
queer.description: Umbrella term used by people whose sexual orientation isn't exclusively heterosexual. Embraces fluidity and non-conformity.

asexual.title: Asexual
asexual.description: Experiences little or no sexual attraction to others. Romantic orientations may vary independently.

demisexual.title: Demisexual
demisexual.description: Only experiences sexual attraction after forming a strong emotional connection with someone.

questioning.title: Questioning
questioning.description: Exploring or uncertain about one's sexual orientation. A valid identity during the discovery process.
